name: Pixel Batching
definition: A Python-side wrapper that samples batch_size random (sensor, pixel) pairs across all sensors, renders those rays to a 1xN box-filter film, and supports a decorrelated PRB backward pass without kernel changes.
summary: Pixel Batching is a ray-centric operation that renders and computes gradients for multiple pixels in a single batch, differing from sensor-centric methods by encapsulating the full forward and backward pipeline.
